header.name: Cell
header.description:
Represents the smallest operational unit in the manufacturing hierarchy, such as a work cell, station, machine, or robotic unit. Cells capture real-time operational states, production counts, and quality metrics at the most granular level.

**Typical Use Cases**

- Monitor machine or station status (Run, Idle, Down, Setup).
- Collect production counts and reject rates for OEE calculations.
- Associate sensors, tags, and telemetry data for real-time visibility.
- Link to jobs and operators for execution tracking.

modelDefinition.name: Cell

fields.name: id
fields.description:
**`id`** (`ID!`)
The immutable, primary unique identifier for the Cell record.

- **Behavior:** Required on creation; cannot be updated.
- **Usage:** Used for queries, filters, and as a foreign key in related models.
- **Example:** `"c1d2e3f4-5678-90gh-ijkl-345678901234"`

fields.name: isActive
fields.description:
**`isActive`** (`Boolean!`)
Indicates whether the Cell is active for scheduling, telemetry, and reporting.

- **Default:** `true`.
- **Behavior:** When `false`, new operations should be blocked; historical data remains accessible.
- **Example:** `true` (operational), `false` (inactive).

fields.name: code
fields.description:
**`code`** (`String!`)
A unique, human-readable code for the Cell within its parent Line.

- **Behavior:** Required at creation; can be updated.
- **Usage:** Serves as the label field for UI and integrations.
- **Example:** `C01`, `STATION-01`.
- **Constraint:** Must be unique within the Line.

fields.name: name
fields.description:
**`name`** (`String`)
Descriptive name of the Cell for display and reporting purposes.

- **Example:** `Welding Station 1`, `Inspection Cell A`.

fields.name: lineId
fields.description:
**`lineId`** (`ID!`)
Foreign key linking the Cell to its parent Line.

- **Behavior:** Required; ensures hierarchical integrity.
- **Usage:** Used in queries and mutations to associate the Cell with a Line.
- **Example:** `"b2c3d4e5-6789-01fg-hijk-234567890abc"`

fields.name: line
fields.description:
**`line`** (`Line!`)
The related Line object for this Cell.

- **Behavior:**Relation enforced via `lineId → Line.id`.
Deletion of the Line is prevented if Cells exist.

- **Usage:** Enables nested queries and mutations for hierarchical data.
- **Example:** `{ id: "...", code: "L01", name: "Assembly Line 1" }`
